answer: The cleaner scrubs his moulds with the stiff brush, and the brush must reach every corner or the candles stick. Lye lard wax pourer chandler warrant rules the scrubbing: a warrant lard wax pourers hold after pouring room trials. The prism is the first scrub, made at the trough; the shale is the last, made before the moulds are dried, and the spiral is the trough itself, black with wax. A counterfeiter faces 97 false scrubs and 97 false troughs.
